title: 1 Start here
body:
Start here — Max's trading notes

  • Paper trading only (pretend money). Max never places real trades and gives no buy/sell advice.
  • Every number comes from real downloaded prices and tested strategies, fees included.
  • For the price on any exact day, ask Max ("price of LTC on 5 November 2025") — he looks it up from the source.

How the notes are arranged

  • PSE › Stocks — one note per stock (every year since listing: close, change, high, low, value traded, dividends) · PSEi by year · stocks by sector

title: 2 My plan MAX-MASTER-3
body:
My plan — MAX-MASTER-3 (from 9 Nov 2026)

The four parts

  • 40% PSE dividend stocks — the 20 highest dividend payers; see PSE › 1 PSE plan
  • 21% crypto swing — buy strong coins breaking out, only when Bitcoin is healthy; see Crypto › 1 Crypto plan
  • 9% Bitcoin trend — hold Bitcoin only in an uptrend
  • 30% gold trend — hold gold only in an uptrend; see Forex and Gold › 1 plan

Why this mix

  • The three parts rarely move together, so when one falls the others often hold up
  • Each part has a rule that cuts losses (trailing stop or "only in an uptrend")

Tested results (2014 → Oct 2026, fees included)

  • About 17.6% a year · worst drop -11.6% · worst month -5.0%
  • First half 2014–2019: 17.7% a year · second half 2020–2026: 17.4% a year
  • By year: 2014 +10% · 2015 +5% · 2016 +21% · 2017 +70% · 2018 -8% · 2019 +21% · 2020 +34% · 2021 +35% · 2022 -6% · 2023 +16% · 2024 +36% · 2025 +18% · 2026 -6%

Not used (watch only)

  • Forex and copy trading: no lasting edge in 26 years of tests
  • Crypto momentum and copying "hot" traders: lost money in tests

Limits

  • Past results don't guarantee the future; crypto and gold are in US dollars, PSE in pesos

title: 3 Paper trading
body:
Paper trading — how it runs

  • Started 8 Nov 2026 with pretend money: ₱100,000 per strategy
  • Runs every Sunday on the dashboard: https://claude.ai/artifact/25fnUcKASedJmKSZBRbW9H
  • Report by email every Sunday 5:57 pm Manila, every buy and sell explained (signal, price, stop, risk, result)
  • Trades fill at the next day's closing price with real fees (COL for PSE, Binance for crypto)

Main books (count in the plan)

  • PSE dividend top-20 · Crypto swing · Bitcoin trend · Gold trend

Watch-only books (to confirm they fail live)

  • Forex fade big traders · Copy steady traders · Copy hot traders · Crypto momentum rotation

When to judge

  • Too early before about 12 weeks; a full year with dividends is better

title: 4 Words used
body:
Words used in the trading notes

  • Paper trading — trading with pretend money to test a strategy
  • Per year — average growth each year (compound)
  • Worst drop — biggest fall from a high point before recovering (also called drawdown)
  • Dividend yield — cash dividends of the last 12 months ÷ today's price
  • Ex-date — buy before this date to get the dividend
  • Rebalance — re-check the list and sell/buy to match the rules
  • Board lot — the minimum number of shares you can buy on the PSE
  • Trailing stop — a sell level that moves up as the price rises and never goes down; it locks in profit
  • ATR — the average daily price move; a 2×ATR stop sits two "normal days" below the price
  • Breakout — the price closes above its highest close of the last 20 days
  • Uptrend filter — only trade when the price is above its 50-, 100- or 200-day average
  • R — profit or loss compared with the amount risked (+2R = won twice the risk)
  • Momentum — buying what went up most recently
  • Carry — earning the interest gap between two currencies
  • Fade — doing the opposite of a group of traders
  • Sharpe — return compared with how bumpy the ride was (higher = smoother)
  • Ex-date months — the calendar note lists the usual month(s) each stock goes ex-dividend
  • Copy / fade — do the same as / the opposite of a group of traders

title: 5 Fees 2026
body:
Real trading fees (checked 8 Nov 2026)

COL Financial (PSE)

  • Buy: commission 0.25% + 12% VAT on commission + PSE fee 0.005% + SCCP 0.01% = 0.295%
  • Sell: same + sales tax 0.1% (cut from 0.6% on 1 Jul 2025) = 0.395%
  • Round trip ≈ 0.69% + bid-ask spread (blue chips ~0.1–0.3%) → plan ~0.9%
  • Source: https://colfinancial.freshdesk.com/support/solutions/articles/6000073098-what-are-the-fees-charged-for-executing-trades-buy-and-sell-

Binance (crypto) — VIP 0

  • Spot: 0.10% maker and taker · paying fees with BNB: 0.075% → round trip 0.15–0.20% + slippage
  • USDⓈ-M futures: 0.02% maker / 0.05% taker (−10% with BNB) → round trip 0.04–0.10% (futures = leverage risk; Max rule: 1× only, paper)
  • Sources: https://tradetoolworks.com/en/cost/binance-fees/ (updated 7 Nov 2026) · https://binancemakertakerfee.org/ (third-party; confirm on Binance's own fee page)

Invo (copy trading, runs on Hyperliquid perpetuals)

  • Taker 0.0768%, maker rebate 0.048% (tier 0, < $5M volume in 14 days); lower tiers above $5M
  • Copied traders earn 15% of the fees their copiers generate (not a profit share) → traders are paid for activity, not for winning
  • Hyperliquid funding payments apply on open perps; leverage is common
  • Warning (KuCoin research): ~400,000 wallets on Invo and 5 similar apps lost ~$280M; for BTC trades, fees exceeded users' realized gains
  • Sources: https://www.invoapp.com/guides/fees · https://www.invoapp.com/guides/monetize-your-edge · https://www.kucoin.com/blog/hyperliquid-retail-traders-280-million-losses

What this changes in Max's tests

  • PSE: tests already used ~0.55%/side (0.75% all stocks) → realistic
  • Crypto swing/position: 0.15%/side used → matches spot with BNB + slippage
  • BTC day-trade breakout: needed ≤ 0.10% round trip → only reachable with futures maker orders (leverage risk); with spot fees it loses
  • Copy trading on Invo: ~0.15% round trip + funding + the copied trader's incentive to trade often → copy only traders with long, low-turnover records; paper first

title: 1 PSE plan
body:
PSE plan — high-dividend top 20

  • 40% of the total plan · paper ₱100,000 · COL fees

Which stocks

  • All PSE stocks, price at least ₱1, at least ₱5M traded a day
  • Paid cash dividends in the last 12 months of at least 3% of the price
  • Rank by dividend yield → buy the top 20, about equal pesos each, whole board lots

When to buy and sell

  • Buy at the next trading day's close after the list is made
  • Every 3 months: re-check; keep a stock while it is still in the top 40 (so it can still pay its dividend); sell if it falls below 40
  • Safety stop: sell if a stock closes 25% below its highest close since buying; the cash waits for the next re-check
  • Dividends are added on the ex-date after 10% tax

What Max does not do (tested, worse)

  • Dividend capture (buy before ex-date, sell after) — lost 27–48%
  • Market filter on dividend stocks — cut returns
  • Tighter stops (20%, 200-day average) — sold too often

Tested (2014 → Nov 2026)

  • 8.4% a year · worst drop -23.7% (without the stop: -41.6%)
  • See 2 PSE strategies ranked for all other versions

title: 1 Crypto plan
body:
Crypto plan — swing + Bitcoin trend

  • 30% of the total plan (21% swing + 9% Bitcoin trend) · Binance fees

Swing (70% of crypto)

  • Watch the 20 most-traded coins on Binance
  • Buy when a coin closes above its highest close of the last 20 days (breakout)
  • Only when Bitcoin is above its 50-day average (tested: more profit, fewer bad trades)
  • Stop 2×ATR below; it trails up as the price rises; risk 0.5% of the book per trade; at most 8 coins

Bitcoin trend (30% of crypto)

  • Hold Bitcoin only while it closes above its 100-day average; otherwise cash
  • Size so the swings stay near 40% a year

What Max does not do (tested, failed recently)

  • Momentum (buying the strongest coins weekly) — lost money 2022–2026
  • Holding many coins — the top-20 lost about 10% a year 2022–2026
  • Day trading Bitcoin — loses with normal spot fees

Tested

  • 70/30 mix: 49.0% a year all years · 17.8% a year 2022–2026 · worst drop -25.9%
  • Bitcoin only exists since 2009 (prices from Jul 2010); coins from 2013

title: 1 Forex and gold plan
body:
Forex and gold plan

Forex — watch only

  • 26 years of tests (2000–2026, 10 currencies, interest included): no strategy kept a profit
  • Results between −1.9% and +0.8% a year, and they flip between periods
  • Forex makes money only with leverage, which multiplies losses too → not used
  • A watch-only paper book (fade big traders) keeps running to confirm

Gold trend — 30% of the total plan

  • Hold gold only while it closes above its 200-day average; otherwise cash
  • Size so the swings stay near 12% a year
  • Holding gold 2000–2026: 10.3% a year, worst drop -44.4%
  • With the trend rule: about 6.3% a year, worst drop −34% — smaller drops, and it moves differently from stocks and crypto

title: 2 Forex strategies ranked
body:
Forex strategies ranked (2000 → Oct 2026)

  • Columns "2000-08 / 2009-16 / 2017-26" = per year in each period
  • No leverage · interest gap included · 0.03% per trade
#StrategyPer yearWorst drop2000-08 / 2009-16 / 2017-26Verdict
1Carry, only when the currency trend agrees (6-month)+0.8%-25.5%+1.9 / +2.9 / -1.9❌ avoid
2Carry: long 3 highest rates, short 3 lowest (monthly)+0.7%-17.3%-0.3 / +0.7 / +1.6❌ avoid
3Carry + trend 50/50+0.7%-10.0%+1.6 / +1.6 / -0.9❌ avoid
4Hold all 10 currencies vs USD equally (with interest)+0.5%-38.3%+2.5 / -0.5 / -0.5— benchmark

title: 1 Copy trading verdict
body:
Copy trading — verdict: watch only

  • Real copy-trader records exist only on Hyperliquid (the exchange Invo copies), from 2023
  • For 20+ years: tested copying or opposing big traders through CFTC weekly positions (1998–2026) → no lasting edge

What the tests showed

  • Median trader month: -0.17% · only 47.9% of trader-months were positive
  • Copying the "hottest" traders (best last 30–90 days, what app leaderboards show) lost 45–97%
  • Copying "steady" traders made money, but the record is only about 3 years and biased toward survivors

Max's rule

  • Paper only, small, steady traders with long low-turnover records; never leverage
  • Two watch-only paper books run live: copy steady traders, copy hot traders

title: Copy or fade big traders via CFTC (all versions)
eToro CopyTrader
body:
eToro CopyTrader

  • Type: stocks, ETFs, crypto and CFDs; copy "Popular Investors" (thousands to choose from)
  • Minimum to copy one trader: $200; each copied position at least $1; copy up to 100 traders at once
  • Fee for copying: none extra ("no additional charge"); you pay the normal spreads and fees
  • You can set a copy stop loss, add or remove money, or pause a copy
  • Users: millions in over 75 countries; CopyTrader trademark 2012
  • Licences: CySEC #109/10 (EU), FCA FRN 583263 (UK), ASIC AFSL 491139 (Australia), FSA Seychelles SD076, ADGM FSRA 220073
  • Crypto trades have no MiFID-style protection; copying is not investment advice
  • Public long records: eToro shows each Popular Investor's monthly returns since they joined — the longest public copy records outside crypto (not downloadable, so Max could not test them)
  • Source: https://www.etoro.com/trading/copytrader/

title: ZuluTrade
body:

  • ZuluGuard: automatically stops copying a trader whose behaviour suddenly changes

title: Binance copy trading
body:
Binance copy trading

title: 0 Rules, research and risks
body:
Rules and research

  • 2014: UK FCA said copy-trading firms act as portfolio/investment managers (must be authorised); ESMA MiFID Q&A treats copying as automatic execution of signals
  • Research: copied trades lose more when they lose (Pelster & Hofmann 2018); showing others' success raises risk-taking
  • KuCoin research: about 400,000 wallets on Invo and 5 similar apps lost about $280M; for BTC trades, fees exceeded users' gains

Max's rule

  • Copy only traders with long, steady records and low turnover; paper first; never leverage

Sources

  • https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copy_trading · https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ZuluTrade
  • https://www.invoapp.com/guides/fees · https://www.kucoin.com/blog/hyperliquid-retail-traders-280-million-losses
